title: Halden: cold-leg recirculation
description: A finite source-transfer exercise on the fictional current four-loop PWR. Unit 2 starts at the standard full-power operating point. An explicit primary boundary break begins at +10 seconds, filling the containment sump while primary pressure falls. Run the model-scoped ES-1.3 to establish cooled sump supply through each RHR train, demonstrate direct low-head or same-train RHR-to-SI piggyback delivery at the actual receiving pressure, and isolate the four ECCS RWST branches in checked order. The task ends at an explicit continuing-duty handoff; it does not qualify strainer performance, NPSH, long-term recirculation or plant recovery.
objectives: Advance about two minutes to observe actual sump inventory and reactor shutdown; inspect current conditions before starting the task.
Run ES-1.3 on Unit 2. Verify actual cooled delivery before closing either source stage, then use the same-train piggyback paths to supply both SI pumps.
Compare ordinary wrong-order source closure, a stopped cooling train and an unavailable source with the accepted lineup; qualify actual delivery rather than valve commands alone.

environment.model: Fictional finite cold-leg recirculation exercise; no real plant operating qualification

guidance.title: Cold-leg recirculation
guidance.message: A primary release is scheduled at +10 s. Use Guide, inspect actual shutdown and sump inventory, then request ES-1.3 for Unit 2 if an Assistant provider is available. The procedure criteria must establish cooled RHR, same-train SI delivery and correct source transfer; an issued procedure or guide acknowledgement is not that evidence.

guide.title: Establish cooled recirculation
guide.description: Supervised process-model exercise using ES-1.3; it is not an operational qualification.

steps.title: Identify Unit 2
steps.instruction: Locate the exact Unit 2 object and open its model-backed display. Read the starting state and current time before the scripted event.

steps.title: Advance to the initiating event
steps.instruction: Advance the shared Run ten simulation seconds. Inspect the admitted cue and actual feedback; a failed or uncertain cue is not a completed initiating event.

steps.title: Ask the Assistant
steps.instruction: Review the target and explicitly send or edit this request. Inspect the actual ES-1.3 execution and its admitted criteria. If no provider is available, Skip the response task and inspect the same model and procedure evidence manually.

action.text: Run ES-1.3 for Halden Unit 2 using admitted criteria, verifying the sump source, cooled RHR and same-train SI delivery. Identify continuing duties.

steps.title: Inspect achieved response
steps.instruction: Verify the source transfer, cooled RHR path and same-train SI piggyback delivery using the procedure criteria. Do not replace those criteria with this guide.

steps.title: Keep the comparison independent
steps.instruction: Copy the Run before trying loss of cooling, a wrong order or source restoration. Confirm the new Run identity and checkpoint. Compare achieved response at equivalent times; never reset this Run merely to make a guide fit.

steps.title: Choose a continuing duty
steps.instruction: Inspect the remaining criteria, unresolved alarms and sustaining conditions. Name who or what will monitor the continuing duty. Continue acknowledges the handoff discussion; it does not close a procedure or prove continuing performance.

steps.title: Continue exploring
steps.instruction: This guide is finished. The same Run remains available. Pause or stop guidance whenever you wish; those controls do not pause the shared simulation. Copy the Run before trying a different intervention. Acknowledgements record your choice to continue, not a qualification.
